name: DocuMind: RAG Q&A over technical PDF manuals
tech: Python, FastAPI, Streamlit, ChromaDB, BM25, Claude API, pytest, Docker, GitHub Actions
description: Built a RAG system that answers questions about PDF manuals with page citations; **91% correct** on a 22-question test set, refused all 4 unanswerable questions, 3.3 s median latency. **Hybrid retrieval** (BM25 + semantic, Reciprocal Rank Fusion) raised MRR from 0.748 to 0.898. Evaluation harness with hit rate, MRR and an LLM judge; 37 offline unit tests, CI and Docker.
